# PokerPerf

> PokerPerf is a mobile poker training app (Texas Hold'em) that turns the right decisions — equity, outs, pot odds, ranges — into reflexes, 10 minutes a day. Available on Android (iOS coming soon), free to start, no real money. The website offers free poker calculators and guides in English and French.
>
> PokerPerf est une application mobile d'entraînement au poker (Texas Hold'em) qui transforme les bonnes décisions — équité, outs, cote du pot, ranges — en réflexes, 10 minutes par jour. Disponible sur Android (iOS bientôt), gratuite pour commencer, sans argent réel. Le site propose des calculateurs et des guides gratuits en français et en anglais.

## Free tools (English)
- [Poker Equity Calculator](https://pokerperf.com/en/poker-odds-calculator/): equity of a hand against one or more hands at every street; exact from the flop, Monte-Carlo pre-flop.
- [Poker Pot Odds Calculator](https://pokerperf.com/en/pot-odds-calculator/): pot odds, required equity, call-or-fold verdict with EV, pot odds chart by bet size.
- [Semi-Bluff EV Calculator](https://pokerperf.com/en/semi-bluff-ev-calculator/): EV of betting a draw and break-even fold equity.
- [Poker Range Calculator](https://pokerperf.com/en/poker-range-calculator/): top X% → hands, combos and standard notation, with card removal (blockers).
- [ICM Calculator](https://pokerperf.com/en/icm-calculator/): tournament stacks + payouts → prize equity (Malmuth-Harville, exact) and the equity needed to get all-in against each opponent (bubble factor).
- [Poker Hand Rankings](https://pokerperf.com/en/poker-hand-rankings/): printable chart, Texas Hold'em probabilities, tie-breakers, "which hand wins" comparator.

## Guides (English)
- [Rule of 4 and 2](https://pokerperf.com/en/guides/rule-of-4-and-2/): estimate your equity from your outs — and when the ×4 does not apply.
- [Poker pot odds](https://pokerperf.com/en/guides/poker-pot-odds/): when to call, required equity, the classic draw trap.
- [What is GTO poker](https://pokerperf.com/en/guides/what-is-gto-poker/)
- [Preflop ranges](https://pokerperf.com/en/guides/preflop-ranges/)
- [Poker math (hub)](https://pokerperf.com/en/guides/poker-math/): every core concept in learning order, with links.
- [Texas Hold'em odds](https://pokerperf.com/en/guides/texas-holdem-odds/): exact preflop, flop and draw probabilities, classic matchups.
- [Poker starting hands chart](https://pokerperf.com/en/guides/poker-starting-hands/): all 169 hands with equity vs a random hand, a button opening range, a 10bb push/fold range.
- [How to count outs](https://pokerperf.com/en/guides/how-to-count-outs/): clean vs dirty outs, exact % per card.
- [Implied odds](https://pokerperf.com/en/guides/implied-odds/): formula, worked example, set mining, reverse implied odds.
- [Poker odds cheat sheet](https://pokerperf.com/en/guides/poker-odds-cheat-sheet/): printable outs/pot-odds/matchups chart.
- [How to study poker](https://pokerperf.com/en/guides/how-to-study-poker/): evidence-based study method (retrieval practice, spacing, interleaving, deliberate practice), weekly plan, sources.
- [Poker blockers](https://pokerperf.com/en/guides/poker-blockers/): card removal explained with exact combo counts.
- [Push/fold charts](https://pokerperf.com/en/guides/push-fold-chart/): heads-up Nash shove/call ranges at 10, 12, 15 and 20bb (chip-EV, no antes).

## How the numbers are checked / Méthodologie
- [Methodology (EN)](https://pokerperf.com/en/methodology/) · [Méthodologie (FR)](https://pokerperf.com/fr/methodologie/): how the equity engine is verified (exact enumeration, Monte-Carlo precision, three independent cross-checks).

## Key facts
- Category: poker decision trainer / education. No real-money gambling.
- Method: decide on real spots yourself, get corrected with solver frequencies, anchor with spaced repetition.
- Accessibility-first: colours doubled with patterns and text, screen-reader labels.
- Android app: [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pokerperf.app)
- Home: [English](https://pokerperf.com/en/) · [Français](https://pokerperf.com/)
